'''Smoked terrafin loin''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Humans" /> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] [[Diet/Legends|ate]] the dish for breakfast the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] his [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|squadron]] took part in a [[Battle of the Corellian Queen|battle]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]] loyal to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]]<ref name="Mindor" /> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Smoked terrafin loin was mentioned in the [[2008]] novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'', written by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="Mindor" />
